text:
Mia: Heads up — main is red after the 2pm merge. smoke suite failing consistently on the embedder-smoke job (timed out at 3m). @Jen did your frontend PR change anything infra-ish? :eyes:

ci-bot: [job embedder-smoke | build/4827] failed on worker gpu-smoke-07 — timeout waiting for model service to return (504). logs: https://ci.example.com/build/4827 

Jen: sorry, that was my PR (frontend/feat/streaming). I only touched the client, but I added a small change to the request headers for streaming which might affect the smoke harness. The PR is a6b9f2c. hmm :grimacing:

Sandeep: thanks — tagging in. quick ask: can someone kick a rerun while I look at logs? I can't repro locally but the stack in CI shows a long stall at ``fetch_model_metadata``. Might be a transient KV cache miss spike.

Alex: rerunning now: `ci retry build/4827` :rocket:

ci-bot: triggered rerun build/4827 -> build/4828. ETA ~6m.

Mia: build/4828 is also red, failing at the same step with `TimeoutError: model service did not respond in 180s`. Logs show repeated `grpc.StreamRead` stalls. Snippet:
```
2024-05-18T19:12:34Z [serve] request 0x7f9f stalled waiting for kvcache miss resolution
2024-05-18T19:15:20Z [serve] grpc.StreamRead timeout after 180s
```

Sandeep: that lines up with a KV allocation regression we saw earlier today in canary — maybe autoscaler is starving the prewarm pool. Can someone glance at the autoscaler dashboard (region us-east-1, pool embedder-low-latency)? If pool size dropped to 0 we should fall back to the dedicated runtime but looks like fallback didn't trigger.

Jen: looking at my change now — nothing about autoscaling. If fallback didn't trigger, could be a routing policy change from the rollout yesterday. cc @Alex do we have a config diff between yesterday and today?

Alex: grabbing config diffs. quick note: I see a recent override in routing policy for embedder that pins model_variant=v2-beta for canary only — might be leaking into main due to label mismatch. investigating.

Mia: action items: 1) Alex check routing label leakage, 2) Sandeep verify autoscaler pool health and trigger fallback manually if needed, 3) Jen confirm PR does not touch routing. If anyone is blocked ping me and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:

Sandeep: autoscaler shows pool dipped from 3->0 at 19:10 UTC. I manually bumped pool to 3 and forced fallback to dedicated for in-flight requests. kicking another rerun after warmup.

Alex: found label bug in the rollout script — a missing `env: canary` check. opened a revert PR (infra/revert/routing-label-leak) and flagged oncall.

ci-bot: triggered rerun build/4829.

Mia: thanks all. let's keep this thread for updates; if build/4829 passes we can close. If it fails we'll collect minimal repro and consider a hotfix rollback.

Jen: thanks Sandeep and Alex — sorry for the noise, will standby. :bow:

ci-bot: build/4829 succeeded. all smoke jobs green. :white_check_mark:
